gamespot.com/articles/first-gta-6-actor-.title: First GTA 6 Actor Officially Confirmed, And It’s A Big Name
gamespot.com/articles/first-gta-6-actor-.excerpt: There's been speculation for months over who could be voicing the GTA 6 cast, but nothing has been officially confirmed, either by developer Rockstar or any of the starring talents, until now. At the BAFTA TV Tea Party, held at The Maybourne Beverly Hills in California, actor Stephen Root was attending in support of his Emmy nomination for his role as Wyck in Apple's Widow's Bay. However, when asked about the rumors around his involvement in GTA 6, Root confirmed (via AP ) that he does appear in the game. "Yeah, you're going to see me in there," he confirmed. "I think from the first rollout of GTA that they were doing almost a year ago they had my character in there, and there were too many people that knew me from King of the Hill and my voice. So, I think that secret kind of got divulged then." https://youtu.be/kTFxs3AcBCQ "I'm so happy to be involved with it; it's an amazing thing to look at," he added. Root, who is known for voicing King of the Hill's Bill Dauterive and playing Milton Waddams in Office Space among hundreds of other credits, will play Brian Heder. Although he didn't confirm as much in the interview clip from AP, Root's distinctive voice makes him easy to pick out from the various GTA 6 trailers. Root played Office Space's Milton Waddams. Brian is a veteran drug smuggler working around the Leonida Keys area and also seems to be protagonist Jason Duval's landlord--although he doesn't charge him any rent. Rather than just a random NPC, Brian seems to be a key figure in the story of GTA 6. He's got his own profile on the official GTA 6 website , for a start. That profile notes that Brian's still moving drugs through his boatyard with his third wife, Lori, but prefers to let others do his dirty work. GTA 6 will be released on November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and Rockstar is hard at work fighting drones and hackers to keep the game's secrets safe.

gamespot.com/articles/wardogs-patch-note.title: Wardogs Patch Notes – Scheduled Maintenance And Patch 0.11
gamespot.com/articles/wardogs-patch-note.excerpt: Over the weekend, Wardogs hit a mammoth peak concurrent count of over 425,000. Today, the game is undergoing scheduled maintenance to improve the server browser experience for players. The servers will be down on Monday, 14 September from 1 AM PT / 4 AM ET / 9 AM GMT for approximately one hour while the patch is deployed. Here's everything included in that patch and what it means for your Wardogs experience. Server Browser Improvements In the patch notes, Wardogs developer Bulkhead acknowledges that the server browsing experience hasn't been as good as it should be. "Community servers have been underserved, and the server browser experience as a whole has been poor," the developer writes. "It is clear to us that we have not put the same amount of care and passion into community servers that we have into the rest of the game." As a result, Bulkhead says it "worked through the night" to put together an update that will "start the process" of improving the server browser, with a focus on community servers. "Community servers are the lifeblood of FPS games like ours," Bulkhead adds. This means that the developer will be "actively" creating technology to support the growth of communities. "We have failed to do that by rushing our community server strategy. As we've always said, when we're wrong, we'll hold our hands up. We got this bit wrong." To address this, Bulkhead will be making the following changes to the server browser: New front-end browser split into community and official There will be a new interface appearing when searching for a server. "A game with this many players realistically should be using matchmaking, and server browsers aren't massively fit for purpose, but we don't want community admins and hosts to suffer." This option for players allows you to choose between joining official or community servers, but doesn't make the experience unfairly weighted toward official servers. gamespot.com/articles/diablo-5-isnt-rein.title: Diablo 5 Isn’t Reinventing The Combat Wheel, It’s Making It Spin Even Faster
gamespot.com/articles/diablo-5-isnt-rein.excerpt: Combat has grown massively between each numbered Diablo game, and for Diablo 5 , Blizzard is aiming to once again elevate those gameplay mechanics to new heights. "Fundamentally, we're an isometric action-RPG, and we're not looking to shake that up with Diablo 5," executive producer Matt Zitterman said to GameSpot at BlizzCon 2026 . "We're looking to improve on it, evolve it, and we have some great, interesting ideas about how to make combat feel even more visceral, even more action-forward. Kind of continuing to build on the success of that fast combat that started in Diablo 3, improved in Diablo 4, and we want to take it even further in Diablo 5. That's really what we're focused on from a combat and gameplay perspective." Zitterman added that Blizzard was also looking to the past for inspiration, picking the best elements from those games and building them into Diablo 5. "Something we talk about a lot on the team is we want Diablo 5 to be a game that feels like it has elements for you, regardless of which Diablo game was your favorite," Zitterman said. "We talk a lot about itemization in the game. Clearly, there's some inspiration being taken from Diablo 2 there, but we're also looking at Diablo 4 and the successes we've had there, and pulling forward ideas from there as well as Diablo 3. I think for us, Diablo 5 represents this really special moment in the franchise's history where we get to look at the past and bring forward things that feel really familiar, but give them a fresh take." https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y8HaSFXR7tU Diablo 5 will launch in 2029 , and this time, Diablo has finally won. Set decades after the Lord of Terror successfully conquered Sanctuary, there's no safe harbor or stronghold to retreat to this time, as players have to keep on the move and recruit allies to their caravan of survivors. Diablo 5 will also give players more character classes to choose from than ever before, including the Monk, Demon Hunter, and the all-new Plague Knight

gamespot.com/articles/overwatchs-tracer-.title: Overwatch’s Tracer Once Shot Lasers From Her Eyes, And It Could Happen Again
gamespot.com/articles/overwatchs-tracer-.excerpt: If early iterations of characters had survived the development process, Tracer could have been a very different Overwatch hero. Speaking to GameSpot at BlizzCon 2026 , game director Aaron Keller mentioned that he had been playing Overwatch since 2013, "since Tracer was shooting lasers out of her eyes." When questioned about such a strange sequence of words, Keller explained that the bizarre version of Tracer came from the first days of Overwatch's engine development in late 2013. "When we were creating the Overwatch engine, you know, so this is late 2013, the first day we got Tracer in we all ran around but we didn't actually have a projectile system yet," he added. "So when you would fire, just like straight out of her eyes, [it was] two red lines." There weren't even any proper visual effects involved at that point. According to Keller, it was "literally two red lines," because the game was firing the weapon from the camera's position. "And so we had a blast running around, just shooting lasers at each others," he recalled. While the laser-eyed Tracer was ultimately replaced by the pulse pistols players know today, the idea apparently hasn't been completely banished from Blizzard's considerations. When asked whether the team might ever bring back a hero capable of shooting lasers from their eyes, associate game director Alec Dawson responded positively. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=gK877kcyMTY "I think shooting lasers out of your eyes is pretty cool. Yeah, we can figure something out," he said. If Overwatch can finally have Jetpack Cat flying around the map, it can certainly have its roster stretched to accommodate laser beam eyes. "I think the possibilities are endless," Dawson added. He also joked that GameSpot's Jessica Cogswell should take credit if a future hero suddenly starts firing lasers from their eyes. gamespot.com/articles/the-last-of-us-2-m.title: The Last Of Us 2 Multiplayer Mod Canceled “On Behalf Of Sony,” Dev Says
gamespot.com/articles/the-last-of-us-2-m.excerpt: Naughty Dog's The Last of Us franchise featured a multiplayer mode in Factions, and while the studio planned to add multiplayer to the sequel, it abandoned those ambitions before release. A modder spent months this year working on a multiplayer mod for The Last of Us 2, but its lead has now said it's not going to be released due to a request from Sony to shut it down. Modder @Speclizer_ said on social media that the mod was due to launch this month. However, they said they "recently received a letter on behalf of Sony Interactive Entertainment requesting for the mod not to be released." https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0_hZQn8_1WA Speclizer said this is an "extremely sad" development, but they hope people who supported the project will stick with them for the next one. Their next project will be "something of my own" as opposed to an extension of an existing game. "Thank you all for the incredible amount of support over the last year. I hope to bring you something bigger and better soon!" Speclizer said. GameSpot has contacted Sony in an attempt to get more details. Naughty Dog was set to expand The Last of Us into an online multiplayer experience in a very big way with The Last of Us Online. The game was in development for years with significant resources dedicated to it, and it was reportedly almost ready for release . However, in December 2023, Naughty Dog canceled the game , saying at the time that it was going to focus on single-player games instead. Also at that time, Naughty Dog confirmed that it had two single-player games in development. One has been revealed to be Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet, while the other remains a mystery; many believe it's The Last of Us 3 . In other Naughty Dog-related news, studio head Neil Druckmann has confirmed that the studio has no creative involvement in the upcoming third season of HBO's The Last of Us . This is a big change, as Druckmann himself was personally and directly involved in the previous two seasons.

gamespot.com/articles/red-dead-2-actor-s.title: Red Dead 2 Actor Shares A Gross Secret About The Game
gamespot.com/articles/red-dead-2-actor-s.excerpt: Actor Roger Clark played Arthur Morgan in Rockstar's celebrated 2018 Western Red Dead Redemption 2, and his performance was memorable for many reasons. In the game, Arthur suffers from tuberculosis, and he coughs a lot as a result. Was it challenging for Clark to perform those sequences in particular? Yes, but it was "not as bad as you'd think," Clark said in a recent interview, in part because sometimes Clark recorded when he himself had a bad cough. Clark told Cade Onder that he had "five years to spread it out," regarding his voice-capture performance in Red Dead 2, and that's part of the reason why it wasn't as difficult as you might imagine. Additionally, Clark said if he was performing a "really bad coughing scene," this would be saved for the end of a given recording day, when his voice was already hoarse from all the work. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ceGnING8zhg Beyond this, Clark said over that five-year period, when he recorded his lines, he, like most people, got sick--and he used this to his benefit. "In five years, there's plenty of colds. There was a lot of data we got that was pretty damn genuine. […] I'd be like 'Hey, I've got a cold, let me get in there.' And they'd be like, 'Okay.' […] Nice good bit of phlegm," he said. In addition to his leading role in Red Dead 2, Clark is known for his roles in the games Fort Solis, Rosewater, and Marathon. He won Best Performance for his role as Arthur Morgan at The Game Awards in 2018. With more than 87 million copies sold, Red Dead 2 is one of the top five best-selling games of all time . Rockstar's next big release is GTA 6 , which launches in November for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Given the immense critical and commercial success of the Red Dead series, a third game from Rockstar (or actually fourth, counting Red Dead Revolver) is expected sometime down the road, but definitely not soon.

gamespot.com/articles/lies-of-p-wizard-o.title: Lies Of P’s Wizard Of Oz Tease May Have Just Gotten A Lot More Interesting
gamespot.com/articles/lies-of-p-wizard-o.excerpt: Lies of P was a big hit when it was first released, and several years after it was confirmed that a sequel was in development , a new trademark by developer Neowiz has popped up online. As spotted on the European Union Intellectual Property Office website (via ThePhraseMaker ), the studio has registered a trademark for " Wonders of O ," suggesting that the game will put own macabre spin on L. Frank Baum's The Wonderful Wizard of Oz books. The listing is for "interactive multimedia software for playing games," but beyond that, no other details on the game can be gleaned from the registration. Lies of P had previously hinted at a trip to the Emerald City; in the mid-credits sequence, a familiar pair of ruby-red shoes could be seen. Neowiz will have free rein to put a souls-like twist on the book--which entered the public domain in 1956--since the original story includes all manner of fantastical creatures. From flying monkeys to the Tin Man, the Wicked Witch of the East and the manipulative Wizard of Oz himself, there's plenty to work with here--and we've got a few ideas of our own for where Agent P can travel to next. Following the launch of the game in 2023, Neowiz continued its twisted rendition of Pinocchio with the Overture expansion in 2025. A prequel, the expansion shed light on the events that led to the Puppet Frenzy massacre and subsequent collapse of the city of Krat. The game also came to Switch 2 earlier this year. Neowiz has periodically spoken about its approach to crafting a Lies of P sequel, and in January, the developer said it was exploring how technology-based solutions , like AI, could be used to "automate routine operational tasks" during game development. While the use of generative AI in games is a controversial topic in the West, in countries like South Korea it's actively used and considered an essential set of tools. gamespot.com/articles/diablo-5-will-have.title: Diablo 5 Will Have The Most Classes Of Any Game In The Series
gamespot.com/articles/diablo-5-will-have.excerpt: Diablo 5 will launch with more classes than any other game in the franchise, according to game director Joe Shely. Shely revealed more details about what to expect from Diablo 5's launch roster during a BlizzCon 2026 panel, following the game's surprise reveal (and Spring 2029 release window) as part of BlizzCon's opening ceremony . During the panel, Blizzard revealed three of Diablo 5's classes : Monk, Demon Hunter, and the new Plague Knight. "Diablo 5 is going to launch with more classes than ever before," Shely said. "And I don't just mean more classes than another Diablo game at ship. I mean more classes total." That means Blizzard is aiming for nine or 10 classes in Diablo 5 at launch, depending on whether or not they are counting Diablo 4's newly revealed Amazon class . https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y8HaSFXR7tU Shely elaborated on how the team was viewing classes, and the number of them coming right out the gate, in a group interview attended by GameSpot at BlizzCon. "What that does...it allows us to, if you started playing Diablo in Diablo 3, you probably know the Demon Hunter, and you can jump into Diablo 5 and have an experience that's familiar and new at the same time," Shely said. "It's a new representation of the class. It's going to be different, but you're still going to have twin crossbows. We're going to pay off that nostalgia you have and that feeling of what that experience was like. Having a lot of classes lets us do that in a way we haven't been able to do before. It also affords us the opportunity to explore new classes like the Plague Knight." With work on Diablo 5 in full swing, Blizzard confirmed Diablo 4 won't receive new expansions going forward. It will, however, continue to receive new seasonal content. Season of Hell's Legacy goes live September 15 and sees the return of Deckard Cain. The iconic Horadrim from previous Diablo games will task players with taking on echoes of the Prime Evils, including Diablo himself. https://www.youtube.

rockpapershotgun.com/this-week-in-pc-gam.title: This week in PC games: become a magic girl in Kernel Hearts, a dog commando in Fright Train, or a capital class warship in Sublight
rockpapershotgun.com/this-week-in-pc-gam.excerpt: Happy new week all! Over the weekend I banished all thought of rocks, paper or shotguns and volunteered to pick apples at a local orchard. Many wonderful varieties were carefully netted, then jumbled together in a huge mesh bag: speckled golden sours, fit to devour immediately with an appreciative grimace; jolly green cookers, wearing their scabs like medals of honour; sharp little reds that slice up into the clearest white wedges. Such intoxicating fruit! As we blundered around with poles and hard hats, we trampled on dozens of fallen, rotting apples, spicing the air with a sickly pungence. It was then that I saw it: the juiciest apple of all, dangling almost within grabbing distance in a peculiar depth of shade, beneath a tree of somehow abyssal provenance - its leaves salt-rimed and its roots akin to sunken steel anchors. I reached and the apple danced back a metre, becoming luminous. By its light, I perceived the slow parting of enormous crystal fangs. Damn it, Maw! I am trying to pick apples in peace. It's just as well I've brought a second mesh bag of new PC games to feed you. Read more

gamespot.com/articles/the-best-overwatch.title: The Best Overwatch Heroes, According To Blizzard
gamespot.com/articles/the-best-overwatch.excerpt: If you've ever wondered which Overwatch heroes the people actually making the game enjoy playing, the answer is surprisingly varied. At BlizzCon 2026 , GameSpot spoke with Overwatch game director Aaron Keller and associate game director Alec Dawson about their personal favorites, their original mains, and the newer heroes they think you should be playing. Here are the best Overwatch heroes according to Blizzard developers: Lucio For Dawson, it all started with Lucio. "My first main, like, 'I want to play this character all the time,' was Lucio, he said. That's mostly down to Lucio's impressive movement, he explained. "When there's a character with very fluid mobility, I'm like, 'I'm going to lock in and learn as much as I can about this hero.'" Lucio's mobility is one of the defining things about his kit. He can wall ride, allowing him to move quickly around the map by chaining movement across walls rather than taking the ground approach. His Crossfade also gives him an area-of-effect speed boost which applies to any teammates within the radius. Combined with wall riding, this makes him especially good at quickly repositioning, escaping danger, chasing enemies, or returning to the point after death, as Dawson agrees. "I think Lucio just spoke to me on a level--I was like, 'Wait, I can do all of those things?' This guy's slide-sliding around walls! That was awesome from the start." And yes, you can count on it that Dawson has used Lucio's Soundwave to boop more than a few opponents down the well in Ilios. Tracer For Aaron Keller, his original main was Tracer. As someone who has been working on Overwatch from its inception, Keller's endorsement of the hero from the original roster is glowing. "I don't know if I have a main now, but my first was probably Tracer," he explained. "I just loved the mechanics. I feel like the kit is almost perfect, the way that it works." gamespot.com/articles/brutally-hard-and-.title: Brutally Hard And Tense FPS Escape From Tarkov Is Cheaper Than Ever Right Now
gamespot.com/articles/brutally-hard-and-.excerpt: There’s never been a better time to be a fan of extraction shooters, with the subgenre of the best FPS games wrapping even the most experienced players in tense, challenging situations. Even with Marathon and Hunt: Showdown giving FPS players a tough time, Escape From Tarkov makes them look almost childishly easy. This is one of the toughest games I’ve ever played, which is why, at its lowest price, it’s the perfect time to give it a try. While Marathon remains a personal favorite of mine, Escape From Tarkov knocks the experience up to eleven. Every step in those fateful raids could be a misstep into death, and like any entry in the subgenre, that means going back to square one. All that gear, the hard-earned stuff you took into the raid, is gone, likely belonging to another player now. Sounds bad? It is, but that’s why every match is so intense and fun. Wearing heavier armor means better protection, but it can also make you slow; like, ridiculously slow. You can arm yourself to the teeth with as much gear as you want, or as little as you need, but a well-placed shot can end the run right where you stand. Battlestate Games pulled no punches in making the game brutal, but the developer also puts its trust in you to eventually figure it all out, inevitably extracting from a run with a bag full of loot and the hope that the next run will be even better. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=OKh9HaTEUfk For years, it existed as a separate launcher, meaning you’d have to buy the game through the developer’s website and play it through a separate application. Thankfully, that’s no longer the case. Escape From Tarkov is finally on Steam, meaning you can dive in and play with other newcomers who are—like you and I—doing pretty poorly. Escape From Tarkov won’t be everyone’s favorite game, and that’s fine. It’s not exactly a casual experience, but for those looking for a militaristic FPS that requires your patience and practice, Escape From Tarkov is just $34.99 / £30.79 at Fanatic

gamespot.com/articles/gta-6s-stephen-roo.title: GTA 6’s Stephen Root Is The Franchise’s Second-Ever Emmy Winning Actor
gamespot.com/articles/gta-6s-stephen-roo.excerpt: Actor Stephen Root recently confirmed that he will appear in GTA 6 , after people correctly identified him as the voice of the drug-runner Brian Heder . He confirmed this on September 13, and on September 14, Root won his first-ever Emmy award for his incredible performance on the show Widow's Bay. In winning an Emmy, Root becomes just the second-ever Emmy-winning actor to appear in a GTA game. The first? That was James Woods, who voiced Mike Toreno in 2004's GTA: San Andreas. Stephen Root in Widow's Bay. Woods has won two Primetime Emmy Awards for Outstanding Lead Actor --he won for Promise (1987), and My Name Is Bill W (1989). Woods also won a Daytime Emmy Award for playing Hades in the animated TV spinoff of Disney's Hercules. Rockstar has not officially announced any casting details for GTA 6, but as mentioned, many people immediately recognized Root as the voice of Heder, and Root later confirmed his involvement in the game. It remains to be seen, however, who voices the game's two leads, Lucia and Jason, or any of the other main cast . Stephen Root's GTA 6 character, Brian Heder. Root won his Primetime Emmy for Supporting Actor in a Comedy Series for Widow's Bay, an eerie, humorous show on Apple TV. He plays the central character, Wyck, alongside Matthew Rhys in the leading role of Tom. gamespot.com/articles/kingdom-hearts-kai.title: Kingdom Hearts’ Kairi Has Suffered Enough, Will Now Headshot You In Fortnite
gamespot.com/articles/kingdom-hearts-kai.excerpt: For the longest time in the Kingdom Hearts series, Kairi has gotten the short end of the stick, but the franchise's upcoming crossover with Fortnite will finally let Kairi fans choose violence. A new trailer for Fortnite's ongoing Chapter 7 Season 4 shows the trio of Sora, Riku, and Kairi in action. The three sport their Kingdom Hearts 2 appearances, and each wields their own Keyblade. They're seen fighting Heartless (or Heartless-like?) enemies in an area resembling their home world of Destiny Islands, hinting that the ever-evolving Fortnite map will add the locale . It's all set to the Kingdom Hearts 2 theme "Sanctuary" by Utada Hikaru, which still slaps two decades later. There's no footage of the Destiny Islands trio wielding firearms, but Sora using a shotgun and Kairi blasting opponents with an assault rifle will be a sight to see when the skins drop later this week. It should be cathartic to a degree to play as Kairi in Fortnite, seeing how she's been treated in her own series. Kairi is often relegated to a damsel-in-distress role, and when Kingdom Hearts 3 ( spoilers ahead for that 2019 game) finally put her in an important position as a Guardian of Light, she... gets kidnapped again and is effectively killed off , leading Sora to literally break the laws of nature to save her. Kairi does have more to do as a playable character in the Kingdom Hearts 3 Re Mind DLC , and she serves as the protagonist of the Melody of Memory rhythm game. But arguably, that's not enough for fans to forgive the sins of the series and its use of Kairi. With Fortnite, Kairi fans can finally blow off steam by mowing down fools with a gun. The next major Fortnite update is expected to drop on Thursday, September 17, and with it should come Sora, Riku, Kairi, and Roxas. It's also expected that Sora's Kingdom Key will be added to the loot pool as a weapon.

gamespot.com/articles/final-fantasy-7-re.title: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation’s Director Kept Coming Back To The Witcher 3 For Inspiration
gamespot.com/articles/final-fantasy-7-re.excerpt: Between the release of Final Fantasy 7 in 1997 and the first chapter in the Remake trilogy in 2020, quite a few games have been released and have gone on to inspire developers. Final Fantasy 7 Revelation game director Naoki Hamaguchi is one such developer, as he explained that games like The Witcher 3 and Horizon helped inspire him and his team to deliver cinematic storytelling native to interactive media, as well as player agency through customizability and scalable world exploration. "Final Fantasy 6 was a very impactful title for me when I was playing the games when I was younger, when I was a child. But as a creator, I would say that The Witcher 3 would fill that role of what inspired game creation," Hamaguchi said to GameSpot. "When I started working on the Remake series, I would frequently go back to The Witcher 3 and just marvel at the things that that game excels at. It's a frequent one that I revisit." https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LRA759MHPJs Hamaguchi added that the Final Fantasy 7 Remake team also wanted to take a different approach to storytelling, as they didn't just want to insert cutscenes into the game world. Hamaguchi says he studied how The Witcher 3 and Guerrilla's Horizon created cinematic pay-offs within the framework of their gameplay mechanics. "We do have to acknowledge that there are certain moments that bring satisfaction that can be only achieved by doing it within the video game medium," Hamaguchi explained. "I think that is exactly something that The Witcher 3 and games like Horizon were really excelling at, just delivering these satisfactory moments. They feel cinematic. That was something that we were trying to follow suit with." More than a decade after its release, The Witcher 3 is still considered one of the greatest open-world games of all time, and it's getting a massive remastered edition on September 29. gamespot.com/articles/james-pond-legacy-.title: James Pond Legacy Situation Is More Than Meets The AI
gamespot.com/articles/james-pond-legacy-.excerpt: Last month, System 3 Software released a trailer for James Pond Legacy, a four-game collection for Nintendo Switch 2. But the gameplay footage was largely overshadowed by accusations its developer used generative AI to create the game's promotional artwork and cover. System 3 followed this trailer up with a blog post asserting that generative AI was not used in the development process for James Pond Legacy, but some wires were evidently crossed. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CFggndxGZk0 If you go back and watch that trailer, it's not difficult to see why viewers pointed out the AI-like quality of the 3D characters adorning the game's box art and other promotional material. When System 3 responded to the accusations with the assertion that "no generative AI was used in the creation of the artwork," referring specifically to the Bovine Bomber character, this was based on the information it was given at the time by Antstream, the studio that handled the collection's actual development. "That was the statement that we were given at the time by Antstream," System 3 CEO Mark Cale told GameSpot during a call. "We weren't involved in the process. They supplied all of the artwork and they supplied, in the process, the [work-in-progress] illustration. All of that was given to us." Cale later provided GameSpot with the statement it received back in December from Antstream, well before the trailer was made public. "The art pipeline on some non-in-game assets includes algorithm-assisted depth and form translation: Original 2D concepts are input into a model to estimate volume and lighting, producing pseudo-3D drafts," reads the statement from Antstream. "Artists then manually repaint, re-render, and finalise all illustrations using this pipeline. The final assets are fully human-authored, with algorithms used only for intermediate visualisation." You may notice that the statement omits the term "AI," which led to some internal confusion. "We requested this [statement] for use

gamespot.com/articles/the-last-of-us-sea.title: The Last Of Us Season 3 Is Probably The Final Season, HBO Says Yet Again
gamespot.com/articles/the-last-of-us-sea.excerpt: HBO boss Casey Bloys has once again said that the upcoming third season of The Last of Us is expected to be its last. He told Deadline that Season 3 is coming in 2027, though did not confirm when in the year. Asked if he still think it's the final season, Bloys said he believes showrunner Craig Mazin "has planned it as the final season." In January this year, Bloys was asked if Season 3 is going to be the last, and he said, "It certainly seems that way." However, at the time, Bloys admitted that a decision like that would come down to Mazin. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uLtkt8BonwM Before this, Mazin said that Season 4 was essential to bring the show to a conclusion. However, Bloys has indicated that the show may wrap up its run with Season 3 , which could be a longer season. “Craig is still working it out whether it will be two more seasons or one more long season. It hasn’t been decided yet, and I’m following Craig’s lead on that,” Bloys said in 2025. In a big shift for the series, franchise creator Naughty Dog is not involved creatively in Season 3 , and Neil Druckmann dropped out as a writer/director. People have speculated about what this could mean, but Druckmann, for his part, said he left the show to focus on his work on Naughty Dog's games. He is currently directing Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet , and if it's true that Naughty Dog is also making The Last of Us 3 , he's probably involved in that, too.

gamespot.com/articles/best-aniimo-starte.title: Best Aniimo Starter To Choose: Helion Or Lunara
gamespot.com/articles/best-aniimo-starte.excerpt: Aniimo has been released as a new free-to-play creature-catching game similar to Palworld and Pokemon. Early in the storyline, the game asks you to make a major decision in choosing from one of two "starter" Aniimo as a guardian. In this guide, we'll discuss the differences between these two Aniimo, so you can make the best choice for your playthrough. Who are Helion and Lunara? Helion and Lunara evolutions You'll encounter two talking Aniimo called Helion and Lunara, who appear to be essential to the game's story and also act as a guardian for your time in the world of Idyll. Only one can accompany you on your journey, at least for now anyway. The story suggests you can reunite with the other Aniimo later in the game, but it's uncertain if they'll be able to join your party. Which Aniimo should you choose? Helion and Lunara comparison There are different ways to approach your choice, as neither Aniimo is a bad option. Maybe you think one Aniimo looks or sounds cuter, and you want it to be your companion for the game. They both look and sound adorable, but Helion looks like a fiery lion cub, and Lunara is a blue and white fox. If you want to think in terms of gameplay strategy, here's a breakdown of the two choices: Both Helion and Lunara are DPS-based, have the same stats, and share the Light elemental type. The biggest difference between the two is going to be their attack styles. Helion will be the best choice if you want close-range, melee-type burst attacks, and Lunara is a great pick if you want to fight with range-based attacks. Again, the two Aniimo are very similar in all ways except visuals and combat style. Lunara might also be the most beginner-friendly pick, as she allows you to fight from a safer distance. Ultimately, the choice is yours. We'll also provide an update if there is a way to later unlock the Aniimo you don't choose for your adventure.

gamespot.com/articles/new-ps5-update-is-.title: New PS5 Update Is Out Now, And Sony Actually Added Some New Features
gamespot.com/articles/new-ps5-update-is-.excerpt: A new PS5 firmware update has arrived, and it's upgrading the console with more than just extra stability. Firmware update version 26.06-14.00.00 offers a new tweak for the PS5 Pro console, voice chat improvements, and tweaks to longstanding features. Here's a breakdown of everything. For PS5 Pro owners, the update will now see the option for enhanced PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR) turned on by default. When this is active, it will allow games to run with sharper, smoother visuals, and it also works with games that support the previous version of PSSR. If you're feeling social, you can also see who's talking when a voice chat group is active--which should come in very handy for games like Big Walk . You'll need to turn this option on, but it's easy to do, and the instructions are listed below. Additionally, new widgets have been added to the home screen. These include a trending tab for new game releases or games with major content updates, as well as multiplayer games and popular multiplayer modes. Bluetooth features for PS5 consoles have been changed depending on which country you reside in, and to cap things off, system software performance and stability have been further improved. This is easily the biggest PS5 firmware update since March , when PS5 Pro consoles received the enhanced version of PSSR . This week's enhancements arrive ahead of a very busy gaming season, as the PS5 exclusive Marvel's Wolverine has launched and other big games on the horizon include Control Resonant , Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 , and Grand Theft Auto 6 . PS5 Version 26.06-14.00.00 Update Notes We've turned on Enhance PSSR Image Quality as a default setting. When you update the system software, this setting automatically turns on. When you enable this feature, enhanced PSSR is used even for games that support the previous version of PSSR, so you can enjoy a sharper and clearer visual experience. To turn off this setting, go to Settings > Screen and Video > Video Out

gamespot.com/articles/resident-evil-dire.title: Resident Evil Director On Who Should Play Lady Dimitrescu In A Resident Evil Village Movie
gamespot.com/articles/resident-evil-dire.excerpt: Director Zach Cregger's latest movie, Resident Evil, hits theaters this week, but if there were to be a movie based on Resident Evil Village, who should play the game's popular Lady Dimitrescu character? That's the question that Pedestrian TV put to Cregger recently. He said his choice would be Christina Hendricks. "That feels about right to me," he explained. Lady Dimitrescu, a tall vampire woman , was one of the most popular characters in Village. She was based on Morticia Addams and other wicked women. The developers at Capcom have spoken about her design, saying they wanted to avoid making her look too much like a Gothic vampire. Hendricks is best known for playing Joan on AMC's Mad Men, for which she received multiple Primetime Emmy nominations. Hendricks is also known for playing Beth in NBC's Good Girls. She is an accomplished voice actor, too, having portrayed Gabby Gabby in Toy Story 4 and Cherie in Solar Opposites. Lady Dimitrescu. Hendricks has one video game credit to her name, and that's the role of Sam Harper in 2011's Need for Speed: The Run. In Resident Evil Village, Lady Dimitrescu is portrayed by Maggie Robertson. She won the Best Performance award at The Game Awards for her performance. It remains to be seen if Lady Dimitrescu could be featured in a movie one day, but the latest Resident Evil movie comes to theaters this Friday, September 18. The film does not feature any characters from the games, though there will be Easter Eggs and nods to the series for fans to obsess over, co-writer Shay Hatten said.

gamespot.com/articles/blizzard-boss-on-w.title: Blizzard Boss On Why Diablo Is Becoming A TV Show And How Involved The Studio Will Be
gamespot.com/articles/blizzard-boss-on-w.excerpt: At BlizzCon , Blizzard announced a partnership with Netflix for an animated Diablo TV show. The announcement caught some by surprise, but Blizzard president Johanna Faries said in an interview that it makes sense for the studio because many people simply don't have the time to invest meaningfully in Blizzard's games, but still might watch a Diablo TV show. “We have so much fandom around Blizzard that doesn’t always necessarily translate into hardcore gaming time,” she told The Los Angeles Times . “This is another way to deepen the relationship with our Diablo community and expand and broaden the conversation with our fans and potentially attract new fans, who may not have the time ... to be able to devote hours to the gameplay, but certainly can devote hours to being engaged in this new form of storytelling." Faries went on to say that Blizzard will be "very involved" with the Diablo show. This isn't always the case for transmedia adaptations, as Naughty Dog recently confirmed it will have no creative involvement in The Last of Us Season 3 on HBO . Additionally, Larian is not involved in the upcoming Baldur's Gate show . https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=M1Tpajd58o8 Lydia Bottegoni, the executive vice president of story and franchise development at Blizzard, said bringing Diablo to Netflix part of an effort aimed at "meeting people where they are." "The franchises themselves and the characters in the worlds have a lot of depth and a lot that we can share," Bottegoni said. It is still early days for the Diablo TV show, and there is no word yet on the story, cast, or release date. It won't be the first Blizzard property to be adapted in Hollywood, as Blizzard and Legendary worked together on the 2016 Warcraft movie. It made just $47 million in the US, but brought in $225.5 million from China alone, finishing with more than $400 million globally. gamespot.com/articles/why-blizzard-stopp.excerpt: After a successful rebrand earlier this year, the mood around Overwatch has been far more positive recently. Speaking to GameSpot at BlizzCon , associate game director Alec Dawson attributed the recent success to ditching the fear of changing core systems--such as the introduction of a Perk system that fundamentally alters hero capabilities--embarking on a year-long narrative, and actively working to break player expectations. "Being able to continue to surprise people is really important," Dawson said. "We've heard a lot from players, like what they're looking for in the game, their return to narrative, and also, more heroes. But at the same time, we're going full-force to those things, but we also want to continue to say, 'Okay, where else can we push? Where else can we actually innovate?' We're just excited to continue to surprise people, and the community's been really receptive to everything we've been doing this year." "It's really about not being fearful of our changes. We have this sense of, 'Okay, we're going to come in and actually expand what your idea of what Overwatch is.' I think that actually, some of the things we've done in the past two years have been at the core of that. The Perk system, in particular, is a brand-new gameplay system for Overwatch, and it changed a lot about what heroes were capable of. We want to continue to push in those things, and look at Overwatch and say, 'Hey, we're going to continue to make the best competitive shooter, but we're also going to do some things that are unexpected, and maybe even mess with the formula a little bit.'" https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RJBAvuK1y2I Keller added that Overwatch's first narrative arc spanning an entire year--focusing on Vendetta and Doomfist’s power struggle for Talon--has also been a big draw for players, as they can't wait to see how this storyline concludes. gamespot.com/articles/nintendos-customer.title: Nintendo’s Customer Appreciation Sale Flubbed The Goodwill Gesture Attempt
gamespot.com/articles/nintendos-customer.excerpt: I love Nintendo. It was a formative part of my video game history, and to this day I think it makes some of the most consistently great games in the industry. But you know what I love more? Deals . For proof just look at my Steam backlog, which is full of games I stupidly bought on the basis of their being cheap. Do I have time to play this? No, but it was so cheap! This is somewhat of a contradiction in my gaming tastes. Nintendo isn't known for offering sales. In fact, it's notoriously stingy with discounts, offering them rarely, and with only modest savings. So I was cautiously optimistic about the Customer Appreciation Sale, which Nintendo promoted as a larger scale sale than usual. The sale is now ongoing and, well, I should have trusted my instincts. These deals are not good. The sale prices are relegated primarily to older games, and while 30% is a larger discount than usual for Nintendo games on the eShop, it still barely makes a dent in the full list price. Since Nintendo games keep their sticker price for years, this sale boasts discounts on years-old games like Donkey Kong Tropical Freeze and Mario Tennis Aces, both from 2018, for a lean $42. Those hoping that newer games would be included are likely left disappointed. A handful of 2025 releases are included--Metroid Prime 4, the Mario Galaxy two-pack, Xenoblade Chronicles Definitive Edition, and Donkey Kong Returns HD. Everything else is 2024 and before. So it's mostly older games, and most of the newest games are ports of older games. And in many cases these are the Switch 1 versions of games, meaning that if you want an optional Switch 2 upgrade, you have to make two purchases, and end up with less than a 30% discount as a result. What a savings So the deals are unremarkable. But so what? I've gone this long without a copy of Astral Chain; I don't need to buy it now for $42. gamespot.com/articles/resident-evil-is-n.title: Resident Evil Is Now The Highest-Rated Gaming Movie Ever
gamespot.com/articles/resident-evil-is-n.excerpt: The Resident Evil movie from Weapons and Barbarian director Zach Cregger releases in theaters on September 18. Reviews from critics went live today, and the movie is earning high scores. GameSpot's Resident Evil review scored it an 8 and said it successfully captures the breathless terror of the games. In fact, it's now the highest-rated video game movie ever. It boasts a mightily impressive 96% on Rotten Tomatoes from 71 reviews and an equally impressive 80 on GameSpot sister site Metacritic. According to Metacritic , Resident Evil is the highest-rated video game movie ever, well ahead of another 2026 movie, Exit 8, which has a 71 Metascore. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mNd1gb19A-c The six Resident Evil movies that Paul W.S. Anderson made did not score very high with critics, with 2016's The Final Chapter topping them all at 49% on Metacritic. The latest Resident Evil movie before Cregger's, 2021's Welcome to Raccoon City from director Johannes Roberts, scored a 44% on Metacritic. After that movie came out, Constantin, which has owned the movie rights to Resident Evil since the '90s, intended to put the franchise on hiatus . However, Cregger, coming off the success of Barbarian, pitched Constantin on his new, original take, and Constantin loved it so much that they put it into production. Video game movies had a track record of mediocrity at best for years, but the tide is turning in recent times. This could be for many different reasons, but some have theorized that part of what made video game movies of yesteryear poor in terms of reception was that, in large part, the game studios and creative minds behind them were not involved in the development process. That's changed now. Oliver Berben, the CEO of Constantin, said that while his team didn't contractually need to consult with Capcom , the film studio did so anyway to ensure it was respecting and caring for the IP and its fans. gamespot.com/articles/wow-forever-is-mor.title: WoW: Forever Is More Than Classic+, It’s WoW 2
gamespot.com/articles/wow-forever-is-mor.excerpt: Going into BlizzCon 2026 , World of Warcraft Classic fans, myself included, were hoping for what the community coined as Classic+. Instead, what we got is essentially WoW 2, an alternate vision for what Blizzard's legendary MMORPG called World Of Warcraft: Forever. It wasn't long after Blizzard re-released WoW Classic, the original version of its genre-defining MMO, in 2019 that players started to dream about what might come next. A community that was at one time dominated by calls for Blizzard to make "no changes" to WoW Classic and keep the game as it was two decades ago gave way to an entirely different desire: more. Sure, it was fantastic and nostalgic to return to the original version of Azeroth and old-school WoW's slower and more methodical gameplay, but what if there were substantial changes and additions? What if there were major class balance changes to make more playstyles viable? What if Blizzard finished zones that were infamously half-baked in the original game? What if some of the zones long teased on the original WoW's map, like Mount Hyjal, were actually accessible? What if there were new dungeons and endgame content instead of the same Molten Core and Onyxia raids players have completed dozens upon dozens of times over the years? The list of possibilities felt endless, but the exact requests and no-nos differed depending on who you asked. As WoW: Forever senior game designer Josh Greenfield told me in an interview at BlizzCon, the "old adage" for Classic+ has always been "ask 10 different people what they want [and] you'll get 11 different answers." https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zerqLHQPN9Y Somehow, WoW: Forever is going above and beyond those community expectations, in often-surprising ways. After going hands-on with WoW: Forever for around two hours at BlizzCon ahead of the game's closed beta on September 17 , I can safely say it delivers on many of the changes the community has wanted over the years. gamespot.com/articles/lego-batman-legacy.title: Lego Batman: Legacy Of The Dark Knight Gives Harley Quinn An Arkham Asylum Makeover
gamespot.com/articles/lego-batman-legacy.excerpt: Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight was a fun tribute to the Caped Crusader when it launched earlier this year, but if you're tired of saving Gotham, you can embrace chaos with two of the city's greatest villains: Harley Quinn and the Joker. The duo are headlining the game's Mayhem Collection expansion, and just like Batman, they're dressing in style with multiple outfits that you can unlock during their caper. GameSpot can exclusively reveal one of them: a classic costume for Harley Quinn, pulled directly from 2009's Batman: Arkham Asylum. And still one of Harley's best outfits. While Harley Quinn predominantly wore a jester's outfit throughout her appearances in Batman: The Animated Series and related comic books, Rocksteady's Arkham Asylum game saw her switch up her look dramatically for what can best be described as a doctor-themed dominatrix. Out with the spandex onesie, in with a repurposed doctor's outfit, leather corset, domino mask, and other elements that paid homage to her roots. In Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight, this costume is described as having prankster pigtails and a "chaotic" corset. https://www.youtube.com/shorts/2Gu8dw37ri4?feature=share In case you missed it, the Mayhem Collection draws heavily from Batman: The Animated Series, with developer TT Games calling the expansion a love letter to the landmark '90s show that introduced Harley Quinn as the Joker's sidekick. Fans can find several references to the series in the Mayhem Collection, along with Easter eggs for other Batman shows, films, games, and comic book stories. There's even a nod to Harley Quinn's original voice actor, the late Arleen Sorkin, and the new story mission chronicles the first meeting between the Joker and Quinn, back when she was still the ambitious psychiatrist Dr. Harleen Quinzel. gamespot.com/articles/fire-emblem-fortun.title: Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave’s Fantastic Reviews Have Me Feeling FOMO
gamespot.com/articles/fire-emblem-fortun.excerpt: Here we go again: A new Fire Emblem game is garnering glowing reviews, and I'm thinking this could be the one that finally clicks with me. Launching tomorrow on Switch 2, Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave sits at a fantastic 89 metascore (at the time of publication) on GameSpot's sister site Metacritic . That's good enough to place it No. 13 currently on Metacritic's list for best games of 2026 . In addition, GameSpot's Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave review says this is "the new high point to beat for future entries." As someone who didn't plan to buy the strategy RPG, I'm now second-guessing myself. I have a history of buying well-reviewed Fire Emblem games, trying them out for maybe five hours, and then bouncing off them for something else. That was especially true of Fire Emblem: Three Houses on Switch in 2019. Before that, my first foray into the series came in 2013 with Fire Emblem Awakening on the Nintendo 3DS, if you don’t consider me maining Marth in Super Smash Bros. Melee. This is a game I still have downloaded on my 3DS XL, which sits in the drawer of my bedside table. I've tried so many times to engage with the game, only to stop after a couple of hours. Once again, I don't dislike the turn-based action, but for some reason, it never fully connects. I'm obviously in the minority, because Fire Emblem Awakening basically saved the entire series . Those previous encounters with the Fire Emblem franchise had me ignoring Fortune's Weave, until now. I see the high praise for the Switch 2 exclusive and feel like I might be missing out on an amazing game. Sure, I'm currently in the middle of playing Blasphemous and have Final Fantasy 7 Remake waiting for me after picking it up on sale. But what if Fortune's Weave is the Fire Emblem game that finally, finally resonates with me? Ahead of Endless Space 's release in July 2012, players who preordered the game got immediate access to an alpha build that was steadily patched and updated on the lead up to launch. gamespot.com/articles/xbox-at-tokyo-game.title: Xbox At Tokyo Game Show 2026: All The Biggest Announcements And Trailers
gamespot.com/articles/xbox-at-tokyo-game.excerpt: The Tokyo Game Show kicked off this week, and Xbox is celebrating its presence with a new broadcast dedicated to showing off what its Japanese partners are up to. The Japanese market has been a tough nut to crack for Microsoft--especially with Sony and Nintendo enjoying a home-field advantage--but Xbox has had a presence there for the last 20 years. Hosted by Misuzu Araki, this year’s Xbox TGS broadcast will offer exclusive content and new gameplay. It's also taking place at a very early hour, and we're betting that you might be sleeping through it. Fear not! As usual, we'll be covering all the announcements during the presentation, and you can scroll below to catch up on all the news and trailers. So, what can you expect from this year's livestream? Microsoft has confirmed that Minecraft Dungeons 2 and Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 will be on the show floor, so we wouldn't be too surprised to see new trailers for those games pop up. Gears of War: E-Day is also out soon, so that could be the focus of another trailer, and we're also expecting developers from across Japan and Asia to feature heavily in the broadcast. This was something that Sony did recently with its September State of Play livestream , as it dropped a bunch of trailers for upcoming games such as Stupid Never Dies, WPCA: World Phasebound Control Authority, and SlashZero. Gachiakuta: Breakout https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UYu__vsFa7k The show is kicking off with a new look at the Gachiakuta: Breakout game. If you haven't seen it, it's a pretty cool anime series about the value of trash--no really--and the manga source material is even better thanks to its cool illustrations. It looks like this will be a faithful adaptation, with plenty of action to enjoy. Crazy Taxi https://youtu.be/cL7btLB6YqA A new Crazy Taxi trailer? Yeah yeah yeah yeah! This fresh gameplay video shows off the new Japanese map you can explore with reckless abandon. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xg

gamespot.com/articles/kingdom-hearts-has.title: Kingdom Hearts Has Invaded Fortnite, And There’s A Lot To Collect
gamespot.com/articles/kingdom-hearts-has.excerpt: Kingdom Hearts has officially landed in Fortnite , and as expected, the update has brought plenty of cosmetics and weapons to the game. The content includes the Kingdom Key, a weapon Epic says can be used to clobber opponents and call down a shocking bolt of lightning when you need to clear the battlefield. If you're running low on health and shields, you can also grab a Sea Salt Ice Cream to top them up for the battles that lie ahead. But once you're underneath the heart-shaped moon on the ol' Fortnite island? That's when you can start using Kingdom Hearts Overrides to your advantage. Players can activate a Recovery Override to gain healing orbs whenever they eliminate another player equipped with a weapon, while the Level Up Override will spawn a Mythic Kingdom Key for each squad member at their current location. Players can also take part in the Kingdom Hearts Power Hour, starting on Saturday, September 19. This will take place at the following times: 11 AM PT - 1 PM / 2 - 4 PM ET 6 - 8 PM PT / 9 - 11 PM ET If you're looking to dress your Fortnite avatar up in some Kingdom Hearts threads, the new Sora, Riku, Kairi, and Roxas will be unlocked in the Fortnite Shop starting September 17 at 5 PM PT / 8 PM ET.  Each one comes with its own Back Bling, Pickaxe, and Lego Fortnite style. While Kingdom Hearts 4 will launch in 2027 , it looks like Fortnite's crossover will help fill the gap until that long-awaited sequel finally arrives--plus, it's cathartic to see Kairi get a chance to kick some butt for once. Ahead of Kingdom Hearts 4's launch, it looks like the game was recently caught up in a massive data breach . If you're not afraid of spoilers, you can click through to take a look at the list of worlds that players can probably explore--if the leaked achievements are correct--which includes Coco and a few other surprise IP in the mix.

gamespot.com/articles/i-played-wow-forev.title: I Played WoW: Forever On A Controller, And That’s Big News
gamespot.com/articles/i-played-wow-forev.excerpt: World of Warcraft: Forever , Blizzard's next evolution of WoW Classic that will see significant changes and content additions, is fully playable on controller. I got to experience WoW: Forever's new Skyborne elf starting zone with the control scheme during a hands-on demo at BlizzCon 2026 . A prompt outlining the controls noted controller support was in an "alpha" state, but despite supposedly still being in early development, it worked surprisingly well. That's a first for Blizzard's MMORPG. Though Blizzard has added barebones support for controllers in recent years, an entirely mouse-and-keyboard-free setup relies on unofficial, player-made add-ons like ConsolePort to deliver a true console-like experience. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uQuKE0KDgiM From what I played at BlizzCon, Blizzard adding a fully featured controller option could be a game-changer. Despite having played WoW on a mouse and keyboard for 22 years, I was shocked at how natural it felt. Cycling through friendly or enemy NPCs is done with the shoulder buttons. Interacting and jumping are done with the face buttons. Abilities and spells are bound to both the d-pad and the face buttons, with additional keybinds accessible by pressing one or both triggers. Each trigger provides access to eight keybinds, with another eight from holding down both triggers at the same time. Combined with the d-pad, you have 28 buttons at your fingertips. That sounds like a lot of buttons, but in some scenarios, particularly in WoW Classic or WoW: Forever, it might not be enough. Certain classes, particularly spellcasters, are notorious for having access to an almost comical number of skills and abilities in WoW Classic. This is largely due to many spells having multiple ranks, with lower ranked versions doing less damage or healing but also costing less mana. That makes them still useful in certain situations, but definitely clutters up one's action bars. Outside of the actual basics of using combat abilities and talk

gamespot.com/articles/gta-6-multiplayer-.title: GTA 6 Multiplayer Could Launch In 2027, Twitch CEO Says
gamespot.com/articles/gta-6-multiplayer-.excerpt: Rockstar has described GTA 6 as a "single-player experience," but everyone expects the game to eventually include a multiplayer element given the enormous success of the existing GTA Online. But when could GTA 6's online multiplayer release? According to Twitch CEO Dan Clancy, fans can expect it sometime in 2027. He said this in an interview with Bloomberg ( via IGN ), saying Twitch spent "a lot of time talking with Rockstar about their plans." He said Twitch stands to benefit from GTA 6's release, too, because content creators will flock to it and stream footage on Twitch. But Clancy theorized an "even bigger" bump to Twitch numbers could come in 2027 "when they launch multiplayer." GTA 6 launches in November. To be sure, Rockstar has not announced anything at all related to multiplayer support for GTA 6. Given that Clancy said his teams had been engaged with Rockstar, his comments come across as more than just random guesswork. GTA 5 also did not launch with multiplayer support. The game released on September 17, 2013, with GTA Online debuting a few weeks later . What Clancy is suggesting is a longer period between the single-player and multiplayer releases. GTA Online has been enormously successful, bringing in lots of money from microtransactions over the years. The game has a dedicated fanbase of passionate players, which might make it challenging for Rockstar to convince people to move on to a new version . GTA 6 releases on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. A PC edition is expected to follow.

gamespot.com/articles/gta-6-boss-says-pc.title: GTA 6 Boss Says PC Is Becoming “More And More Important”
gamespot.com/articles/gta-6-boss-says-pc.excerpt: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 launches in November for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S, but is it also going to release on PC? It won't at launch, but history suggests it will come to PC further down the track. Now, Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick has commented on the company's approach to PC releases generally. At the company's virtual shareholder meeting today , as reported by GamesRadar , Zelnick said Take-Two's general approach is that the company will put out games "for any platforms for which there is a meaningful audience." Intriguingly, Zelnick went on to say that, "the PC is becoming more and more important to our company over time." Again, he was not talking about GTA 6 here, but rather Take-Two's approach to PC generally. In any event, these comments only further the idea that it's a matter of when, not if, GTA 6 comes to PC (of course). Historical precedent for Rockstar's PC releases Rockstar's latest releases, including Red Dead Redemption 2 (2018) and Grand Theft Auto 5 (2013) launched first on console and later came to PC. GTA 5 came to PC in April 2015, which was 18 months after the game originally launched on console in September 2013. Red Dead Redemption 2, meanwhile, came to PC faster. The game's PC edition released in November 2019, which was just about a year after the game debuted on console in October 2018. What does it all mean for GTA 6? We don't know, but it's a safe bet that GTA 6 will eventually come to PC, and people should likely expect to wait at least a year. Rockstar and Sony have a co-marketing deal for GTA 6, but that's not the reason why GTA 6 isn't coming to PC at launch .  Zelnick told Bloomberg that Rockstar Games is known to launch GTA games first on console before PC, and that is because, “I think with regard to a release like that you’re judged by serving the core [audience].” When Zelnick joined Take-Two in 2007, he said PC sales made up only around 5% of total sales volumes for the NBA 2K series. gamespot.com/articles/games-price-is-low.title: Game’s Price Is Lower Because This Fall Is So Packed, Dev Admits
gamespot.com/articles/games-price-is-low.excerpt: October is going to be a tough month for anyone on a budget, as a ton of big games are coming up. Sandwiched between an already-packed September and the November release of GTA 6 , how does any game stand out from the pack? In the case of Valor Mortis, a launch price of $40--and day-one availability via Xbox Game Pass--might be a winning combination to help it shift units. "We've had many discussions over the past year about the price of Valor Mortis," developer One More Level and publisher Lyrical Games wrote in a statement. "We believe the game has the quality, fidelity, and playtime in its 20-hour story to go toe-to-toe with many 'full price' titles. Still, this fall is stacked, and there's high demand for your time and money." https://twitter.com/ValorMortis/status/2100570811677770189 One More Level added that cosmetic packs will also be released in the next few months, and if players want to support the studio, they can purchase a Deluxe Edition that includes unique weapon skins alongside the base game and a "major" story expansion arriving in 2027. Speaking to The Game Business , Lyrical Games boss Blake Rochkind said the decision to price Valor Mortis at $40 came from confidence in the game. "We find ourselves as one of the only new IPs launching in what is objectively the craziest fall in the history of this business," Rochkind said. "Not only do you have GTA looming large in November, now you have the Zelda remake, Control coming out in a couple of weeks, Silent Hill: Townfall, Phantom Blade Zero, Gears of War, Call of Duty--by virtue of the development schedule, the cards we’ve been dealt is that we are one of the only new IPs launching this fall." Rochkind added that selling Valor Mortis for $40 allows it to be an "and game," something that players could add to their basket while purchasing one of the high-priced titles out later this year. gamespot.com/articles/gta-is-like-barbie.title: GTA Is Like Barbie, Take-Two Boss Says
gamespot.com/articles/gta-is-like-barbie.excerpt: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 is one of the most-anticipated game releases ever, and despite the enormous hype, Rockstar and owner Take-Two are going to market the game aggressively. Why does the game even need a marketing push? According to Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick, just because a franchise is popular and well known, that doesn't mean the company behind it can take their foot off the pedal in terms of spending time and money on marketing. Zelnick said 2023's The Barbie Movie is a good example of this. “All of us saw the Barbie movie, and they marketed the living daylights out of that picture. Even though the IP is very well known. Secondly, it was out there for a while. We all got the joke of what it was going to be. They did a phenomenal marketing campaign. It was really everywhere, and, by the way, it worked," he told GamesBeat . Lucia and Jason in GTA 6. For any "broad-based entertainment" property, companies "don't have a choice" but to spend significantly to push a new release, and GTA 6 is no exception, Zelnick said. "You always have to go out and create enthusiasm. So, awareness is one thing; enthusiasm is another thing. And we have to show people what they’re going to get," Zelnick said. He said Take-Two's investors have asked him why the company needs to aggressively push GTA 6 when it's a game everyone on Earth knows about. Zelnick said he learned from his time as a movie executive years ago that if your product is no good, "you can market the living sh** out of it, and people will still not notice the marketing." And if the marketing is terrible, "you can turn people off." If the marketing is good, however, "you can create more excitmement." "And the whole goal that we always have, whether it’s this upcoming launch or any other title, is to take awareness and turn it into excitement, and take the lack of awareness and turn it into awareness," he said. As part of yesterday's Xbox Tokyo Games Show event, Netmarble shared another look at Bloomwalker , its upcoming crafting adventure. Aside from announcing that the game will launch on Switch 1 & 2, the studio also revealed that the title is officially part of the Ni no Kuni universe. It has been a little while since we got a first peek at Bloomwalker, but it looks like it'll be right at home on Nintendo consoles. It's got all manner of cosiness that we love to see on the system, as you travel across a pollution-ravaged land with your moving house (yes really) and adorable nature spirit pals, and there's more than enough crafting that we can imagine portability will be a welcome addition.
